newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African holiday road death toll 910 - and rising.
newsitem.headline: S.African holiday road death toll 910 - and rising.

text.p: At least 910 people have died on South Africa's roads during the Christmas holiday break and the toll is expected to rise, officials said on Sunday.
Traffic officials said in a statement they expected more deaths when holiday-makers returned home to the industrial heartland after summer vacations at coastal resorts.
They blamed the toll on drivers who disobey traffic rules. No comparative figures for the same period of 1995 were given, but the latest death toll was believed to be sharply higher.
